endorsements.quote: As these technologies move from tertiary centers into broader clinical practice, it is essential for both clinical and non-clinical professionals to develop a clear understanding of core AI concepts and their practical applications.

unlisted_practices: Incorporate human oversight of generative AI outputs to ensure accuracy and patient safety.
Connect AI tools to validated medical databases and design prompts that constrain outputs to reliable boundaries to mitigate hallucination.
Use retrieval-augmented generation to anchor LLM outputs to verified sources.
Critically evaluate the composition of training data and augment datasets with representative examples from underrepresented groups to minimize bias.
Do not enter patient data into non-HIPAA-compliant public LLM tools because inputted data may be used for further model training.
